Binance Names Justin Yek New CFO as Kaiser Ng Plans to Leave

According to Bloomberg, Binance has appointed Justin Yek as its new chief financial officer (CFO), replacing Kaiser Ng, who is leaving to pursue a new venture. Binance co-CEO Yi He said Ng had been with the company for more than five years and that a transition plan had been in place for the past six months. Yek previously served as vice president of finance at Airwallex and head of Southeast Asia technology investment banking at Morgan Stanley. Ng previously served as CFO of Kraken. — link
